tasks.title: Announcement #53
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Attention everyone, we are thrilled to announce that the university's annual charity auction will be held next Saturday at 6 PM in the main hall. All proceeds will go to local charities. We hope to see you there and appreciate your support.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Attention everyone, we are thrilled to announce that the university's annual charity auction will be held next Saturday at 6 PM in the main hall. 选项分析： A. An upcoming charity auction 一场即将到来的慈善拍卖会。公告明确宣布年度慈善拍卖会的时间地点，所以A选项正确。 B. A donation drive 一场捐赠活动。公告提到的是拍卖会而非直接捐赠活动，所以B选项错误。 C. A change in venue 场地变更。公告中没有提到场地变化，所以C选项错误。 D. A new university event 一项新的大学活动。公告说的是“annual”（年度）活动，不是新的，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：We hope to see you there and appreciate your support. 选项分析： A. Donate online 在线捐赠。公告中未提及在线捐赠，所以A选项错误。 B. Attend the auction 参加拍卖会。说话者明确说“hope to see you there”，希望听众到场，所以B选项正确。 C. Prepare for a lecture 准备一场讲座。公告中未提及讲座，所以C选项错误。 D. Volunteer at the event 在活动中做志愿者。公告中未提及招募志愿者，所以D选项错误。
